messages:
Amy: Quick follow-up after the policy DSL RFC. We need to decide the admission/eval shape: synchronous per-request eval vs fast local decision + async authoritative check. Pros/cons?
Ben: Sync keeps behavior simple and debuggable. Rollback is straightforward.
Carla: Sync risks adding p95. If matchers get heavier we'll pay a latency tax. Suggest a cached fast-path.
Ed: Two-tier makes sense: lightweight sidecar for hot path, central policy service for authoritative accounting and complex rules. Sidecar returns decision + provenance header.
Frank: Cache invalidation across regions is painful. We need versioned keys, TTLs, and an invalidate bus. Also decide stale-while-revalidate behavior.
Gina: Drafting a sample DSL scoring rule for discussion:
```policy
rule "region_cost_mix" {
  match { tenant.tier in [\"free\",\"standard\"] }
  score = 1.2 * cost_usd + 0.8 * latency_ms
  tie_breaker = prefer_local
}
```
Gina: Important: normalize scores to a bounded numeric range so runtimes can compare and combine reliably.
policy-bot: REMINDER: policy API responses must include policy_version and a short reason field. Use X-Policy-Version for canaries.
Amy: Action items for this week: (1) sidecar <-> control-plane wire contract, (2) cache key semantics & TTL, (3) runtime compatibility/versioning plan, (4) canary rollout + auto-rollback checklist.
Ben: Prototype POST /policy/eval payload: POST /policy/eval { tenant_id, model, input_hash, region_hints } -> { decision: \"accept\"|\"fallback\"|\"queue\", score: 12.3, policy_version: \"v2026-03-12\", reason: \"cost<=threshold\" }
Carla: Keep explainability small: reason <= 256 chars, plus structured tags array for analytics. Small payloads only.
Ed: Include a stable request_fingerprint (sha256(tenant|model|sig)) so caches are deterministic across retries.
Frank: Runtime should advertise supported policy_version ranges. If control-plane sends unknown policy, runtime falls back to safe heuristic and emits telemetry.
Gina: Add a sim job: 10k synthetic requests with region churn + model hot spikes. Validate p50/p95 and reconciliation accuracy.
Amy: Ops: control plane exposes /policy/versions and a 2-week deprecation window for breaking changes. Canary via tenant opt-in header + rollout fraction.
Ben: Owners: Ben+Frank sidecar+cache, Carla+Ed policy service & wire, Gina proxy canary header + sim, Amy RFC addendum + rollout checklist.
Carla: Fallback semantics must be explicit. If sidecar does fallback->variant_B but authoritative disagrees later, log both and reconcile metrics; do NOT retroactively cancel already-sent responses.
Ed: Reconciliation rule: sidecar decision stands for latency-critical path; authoritative decision annotates final_decision and can trigger compensating metrics/events.
Frank: Security: policy inputs may include tenant signals; sidecars must not leak cross-tenant state. Encrypt policy_version in transit and ensure authn.
Gina: I'll add perf profiling gates before canary.
Amy: I'll write the RFC addendum and tag owners. Sync meeting Friday 10:00.
Ben: :thumbsup:
Carla: ack
Ed: ack
Frank: ack
Gina: ack
policy-bot: Task created: #POLICY-EDGE-456 (owners: Ben,Frank,Carla,Ed,Gina)
Amy: Thanks, filing addendum link in #arch-rfcs when ready.
